workarounds.symptom: POWERSHELL_UNQUOTED_EXPRESSION_STRIP: PowerShell strips double quotes inside inline python -c commands, resulting in SyntaxError: invalid syntax
workarounds.workaround: Write inline python scripts to a temporary file via write_file or wrap in escaped single quotes without nested shell expansion.

workarounds.symptom: PowerShell 5.1 (default Windows 10/11) rejects '&&' syntax with 'ParserError: The token && is not a valid statement separator'. Agent enters retry loop trying bash chaining.
workarounds.workaround: Use ';' sequence with '$?' check: '<cmd1>; if ($?) { <cmd2> }' or invoke via 'cmd /c "<cmd1> && <cmd2>"'.

workarounds.symptom: PowerShell aliases 'curl' to Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.InvokeWebRequest. Running 'curl -X POST -H ... -d ...' throws positional parameter errors or strips quotes from JSON payload.
workarounds.workaround: Always invoke 'curl.exe' explicitly or wrap commands in 'cmd /c "curl.exe ..."' with escaped quotes.
